description: Data Trust Explorer with three visually labeled lanes: Now, Run, Range. First screen promotes current reasons; range freshness is supporting impact.

panels.title: Review Dashboard Navigation
panels.description: Sanitizer-compatible navigation bus with native keyboard focus. Primary bus: Trust / Overview / Pipeline Diagnostics / Data Quality. Provider Health remains interim/off-bus. Handoffs open same-tab, preserve current time range, and document scope reset or context mapping on cross-scope transitions.

panels.title: Provenance
panels.description: Unified context/provenance banner for 4. Data Quality. Scope: workflow=$workflow, pipeline=$pipeline, run_type=$run_type, run_id=$run_id, selected Grafana time range. Workflow is context/evidence unless documented otherwise; run_id is local control-plane identity context only. Visible scope badges distinguish CURRENT, SELECTED RUN, and TIME RANGE evidence.

options.content:
Is data conformant, and what delivery impact needs action?
Scope: CURRENT = Status/reasons · SELECTED RUN = ID/Processed Records · TIME RANGE = score, freshness and impact cards below. Do not compare different badges as peers.

panels.title: Status
panels.description: NOW-lane current DQ status only (bioetl_dq_current_status). Not comparable to Range freshness or Run reject tables as a peer badge. Primary compact Data Quality verdict for the selected pipeline scope. Status mapping: 0=OK, 1=WARN, >=2=CRIT, null=UNKNOWN. Workflow is context/evidence only; run_id is local control-plane identity context and does not filter Prometheus. Monitor DQ Current Status below is an expanded first-screen mirror of this same current-status recording rule, not an independent second verdict. Sole first-screen status (dual twin removed #6572).

panels.title: Review: First Action

options.content:
First Action — three lanes (not peer badges)

Now: Status + threshold + current reasons (conformance now).

Run: expand Silver/Gold reject rows for structural/quarantine evidence.

Range: freshness / attrition impact — do not compare as peer severity to Now.

panels.description: Data Trust Explorer CTA. Three evidence lanes: Now (current rules/state), Run (rejects/quarantine), Range (freshness/impact). These are not peer-comparable severity badges. Operator CTA for first-pass DQ triage. It explains what to do for CRIT versus WARN states, clarifies that the answer row above is pipeline-wide current state while run_type and stage mainly shape selected-range evidence, and explicitly distinguishes reject-path evidence from quarantine/validation blockers when filtered_out remains zero.

Status mapping: 0=OK, 1=WARN, 2=CRIT; null=UNKNOWN. Threshold state stays bounded: hard-fail reasons map to CRIT, warning-only reasons map to WARN, and explicit current OK stays OK. Disabled or noop DQ monitoring is treated as a warning-state reason, not unconditional green. Current threshold state is pipeline-wide; use selected-range panels below for scoped evidence.
panels.title: Monitor DQ Threshold State

panels.description: Current DQ reasons table with severity and action_target. Soft threshold/quarantine map to WARN; hard validation/anomaly/silver validation map to CRIT. A pipeline can be CRIT here even when filtered_out is zero because quarantine and silver validation are separate blocker paths. Empty table means no active DQ reasons are currently above zero for the selected pipeline snapshot.
panels.title: Inspect DQ Current Reasons

panels.description: TIME RANGE freshness age in hours. Explicit SLA: WARN at 24h and CRIT at 72h. An ~8h value is green only because it is below the visible 24h SLA; null is UNKNOWN.
panels.title: Time Range · Worst Freshness Age (hours; SLA 24/72)

panels.description: TIME RANGE delivery impact. Selected-range blocked-record evidence only. Counts Silver filter rejects plus DQ quarantine records for the pipeline/run_type window without applying entity YAML thresholds in Grafana. Read alongside the adjacent Track: Source Records in Range (Bronze) panel for the denominator/magnitude context, and rely on Monitor DQ Current Status / Monitor DQ Threshold State (bioetl_dq_current_* recording rules) for the soft/hard severity verdict instead of the absolute count. 0 means no blocked records were observed in the selected window.

targets.expr: round((sum(max_over_time(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", stage="filtered_out"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(max_over_time(bioetl_dq_records_quarantined_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type"}[$__range])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Track: DQ Blocked Records in Range (Evidence)

panels.description: Silver structural reject reconciliation signal. Non-zero means the stage-total filtered_out counter diverges from the bounded Silver reject breakdown metric over the selected range. Gold contract/semantic reject outcomes are excluded from this guardrail.
panels.title: Monitor: Silver Filter Reject Accounting Mismatch

defaults.noValue: No reject reason samples in range

panels.title: Inspect: Top Silver Reject Reasons (Pareto)
panels.description: Pareto ranking of bounded Silver structural reject reasons across the selected range. Use the direct Silver Reject Explorer drilldown on each bar to open record-level detail already filtered by pipeline/run_type/reason_code and then validate representative payload_hash rows. Gold contract/semantic rejects are intentionally excluded. No data means no bounded reject breakdown samples were observed in range; the panel must not invent a synthetic reason bucket.

defaults.noValue: No reject field samples in range

panels.title: Inspect: Top Silver Reject Fields
panels.description: Bounded Silver structural schema-field summary for the selected range. Use the direct Silver Reject Explorer drilldown on each bar to open record-level detail already filtered by pipeline/run_type/field and then compare top reason signatures inside the explorer. Gold contract/semantic rejects are intentionally excluded. No data means no bounded reject field samples were observed in range; the panel must not invent a synthetic field bucket.

Selected-range pipeline breakdown of Silver structural rejects from the filtered_out stage-total counter. This is a scope/distribution panel, not a reason_code summary, and it intentionally excludes Gold contract/semantic rejects. No data means no filtered_out samples were observed in the active window; the panel must not invent a synthetic pipeline row.
panels.title: Inspect: Silver Filter Rejects by Pipeline

panels.description: Selected-range Gold reject outcomes by pipeline. This panel separates Gold contract quarantines and semantic/contract exclusions from Silver structural FILTERED_OUT_SILVER rows; use it when DQ pressure is not explained by the Silver Reject Explorer. No data means no Gold reject outcome samples were observed in the active window.

defaults.noValue: No Gold reject samples in range

panels.title: Inspect: Gold Reject Outcomes by Pipeline

panels.description: Selected-range evidence only. This panel no longer drives current DQ status; use Monitor DQ Current Status for incident state. Dense legend is hidden by default; full identifiers remain available in the tooltip/detail row.
panels.title: Track Range Evidence: Bronze -> Silver -> Gold

panels.description: Selected-range Bronze denominator for DQ triage. 0 means no Bronze records were observed inside the active window; it does not prove DQ metrics are missing. Compare with Gold output and blocked-share panels below.
panels.title: Track: Source Records in Range (Bronze)

panels.description: Selected-range Gold output count for DQ deliverability triage. 0 means no Gold records were observed inside the active window; it does not prove the current DQ verdict is OK or UNKNOWN. Compare with Bronze denominator, blocked-share, and the shared Processed Records table before interpreting data loss.
panels.title: Track: Clean Records in Range (Gold)

panels.description: Selected-range count of Silver validation failures. Non-zero means Silver validation blocked or degraded promotion in the active window, and this can drive current CRIT even when filtered_out stays zero. Correlate with current DQ reasons and quarantine evidence before replay.
panels.title: Track: Silver Validation Failures in Range

panels.description: Latest successful data timestamp for the selected pipeline scope. This is current freshness context and compact supporting evidence rather than a first-answer verdict or selected-range proof. UNKNOWN means no freshness proof is available now; next action: inspect DQ Current Reasons and the DQ investigation runbook before treating stale or blank values as healthy.
panels.title: Review: Latest Successful Data Timestamp

panels.description: Selected-range quarantine breakdown by error_type. Use it to determine whether current DQ pressure is dominated by a specific quarantine signature before moving to logs, traces, or downstream validation surfaces. Horizontal bars are intentional here because category comparison matters more than composition percentage. No data means no quarantined records were observed in the active window; the panel must not invent a synthetic error_type bucket.
panels.title: Inspect: Quarantine by Error Type

panels.description: Selected-range count of canonical Silver validation failures. Non-zero means Silver validation blocked or degraded promotion and should be correlated with current DQ reasons and reject/quarantine evidence.
panels.title: Monitor: Silver Validation Failures

panels.description: Selected-range Gold strict-validation hard-fail count. Non-zero means Gold promotion was blocked. Zero means no hard-fail samples were observed in the selected window; it does not prove Gold validation ran or that Gold output exists.
panels.title: Monitor: Gold Strict Validation Failures

panels.description: Selected-range anomaly counts by severity and anomaly type. WARN-only anomalies indicate drift; CRIT anomalies are blocking and should be correlated with current DQ reasons before replay or promotion. No data means no anomaly events were observed in the current window; the panel must not invent a synthetic severity/type series. Dense legend is hidden by default; full identifiers remain available in the tooltip/detail row.
panels.title: Track: Anomalies Detected

panels.description: Selected-range p95 duration of DQ checks. This is a diagnostics/performance surface, not a quality outcome; use it when DQ checks themselves look slow or noisy during an incident. Samples exist only when the runtime emitted bioetl_dq_check_duration_ms, which requires an active DQ monitor path rather than disabled/noop monitoring. No data means no DQ duration samples were observed in range or DQ timing telemetry is absent; it is not equivalent to fast checks. Dense legend is hidden by default; full identifiers remain available in the tooltip/detail row.
panels.title: Track: DQ Check Duration (p95)

panels.description: Selected-range trend of domain-emitted DQ threshold events. Uses bioetl_dq_soft_threshold_exceeded_total and hard_fail validation counters only; Grafana does not recompute entity YAML thresholds here. Dense legend is hidden by default; full identifiers remain available in the tooltip/detail row.
panels.title: Track: DQ Threshold Events in Range Trend

panels.description: Quality score trend over selected time range. Kept separate from operational gating indicators. Score thresholds: <0.80=CRIT, 0.80-0.95=WARN, >=0.95=OK; null=UNKNOWN. Dense legend is hidden by default; full identifiers remain available in the tooltip/detail row.
panels.title: Track: Data Quality Score Trend (Volume-weighted)

panels.description: Lineage-reference gaps remain a replay/control-plane trust signal owned by `0. Control Plane`. This DQ surface keeps only a compact handoff so the trends row can stay focused on local DQ evidence. Open the canonical control-plane panels when missing lineage must be reviewed together with replay blockers, manifest / ledger evidence, and artifact identity anchors.

options.content:
### Open Control Plane for lineage trust
- Use **0. Control Plane** for the canonical `Monitor: Lineage Refs Missing` signal.
- Review lineage gaps together with replay blockers, manifest / ledger integrity, and artifact identity anchors.
- This DQ row keeps local reject, quarantine, validation, and trend evidence separate from control-plane trust ownership.

dataLinks.tooltip: Canonical lineage/replay trust surface. Opens the Control Plane dashboard focused on its lineage diagnostics row.

panels.title: Review: Lineage Handoff to Control Plane

panels.description: Compact handoff note for aggregate control-plane symptoms. Keep this as footer guidance only; operational evidence still lives in `0. Control Plane` and its runbook surfaces.

options.content:
### Use Control Plane for aggregate failures
- Open `0. Control Plane` for aggregated manifest writes, ledger appends, checkpoint compatibility outcomes, and control-plane read failures.
- Use the `Observability Checklist (runbook)` link when `BioETLControlPlaneReadFailureRate` or related aggregate signals require operator follow-up.

panels.title: Review: Aggregate Control-plane Handoff
Monitor: Data Quality Score (Volume-weighted)
panels.description: Latest volume-weighted DQ score retained for up to 7 days between runs on the canonical 0.0-1.0 ratio scale, where 1.0 means all records are valid. UNKNOWN means no matching score and record-count samples exist in that window; absence is never coerced to 0. Review raw sample history in the adjacent trend panel. Scope: selected-range and pipeline scope only.

panels.title: Monitor: Worst-Entity DQ Score
panels.description: Latest pipeline-scoped worst-entity DQ score retained for up to 7 days between runs on the canonical 0.0-1.0 ratio scale, where 1.0 means all records are valid. UNKNOWN means no matching validation score sample exists in that window, not a successful run and not a zero score.

TIME RANGE delivery impact. Selected-range quarantine count. Non-zero means records were withheld from normal promotion and require quarantine triage even when Silver filter rejects remain zero; 0 means no quarantined records were reported in the selected window.
panels.title: Track: Records Quarantined in Range
Track: Silver Filter Rejects in Range
panels.description: TIME RANGE delivery impact. Selected-range Silver structural reject count from the filtered_out path only. FILTERED_OUT_SILVER is a legacy alias for this Silver structural path and is not a Gold contract/semantic reject code. A zero here does not refute current CRIT because quarantine, Gold reject outcomes, and Silver validation blockers are separate paths; use first-screen DQ reasons and the quarantine/validation/Gold panels before assuming the incident is filter-driven. The Explorer handoff preserves pipeline/run_type and time range so the operator can validate scoped totals before narrowing by reason_code or field.

panels.title: ID
panels.description: Compact two-column local control-plane identity table. Shows Run ID, Manifest ID, Provider.Entity [Version], Contract [Schema], Execution, execution flags, Replay [Capability.Mode], Checkpoint [Anchors], optional Composite Run, and Identity Health. Exact selected run_id wins; aggregate pipeline scope without exact run_id must not guess one manifest identity; values come from HTTP, not Prometheus labels. No data/datasource errors on this HTTP-backed card mean the BioETL Ops HTTP/control-plane backend may be unavailable; verify /health/live before interpreting the card as expected empty. Fail-closed: timeout, empty, or unresolved identity/accounting must render UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE/NO DATA — never a synthetic healthy zero.

defaults.noValue: Not resolved — no identity rows for the selected run/scope. Check backend health (/health/live), then select or reset run_id; this is not a valid empty run.

panels.title: Processed Records
panels.description: Current Bronze/Silver/Gold stage/outcome accounting evidence for the shared pipeline/run_type context. Uses bounded stage/outcome accounting recording rules; missing accounting series render UNKNOWN/no data, not OK. Summary status, accounted subtotal, and delta rows are intentionally not displayed in this compact table; use Status and detailed recording rules for verdict/delta triage. No data/datasource errors on this HTTP-backed card mean the BioETL Ops HTTP/control-plane backend may be unavailable; verify /health/live before interpreting the card as expected empty. Fail-closed: timeout, empty, or unresolved identity/accounting must render UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE/NO DATA — never a synthetic healthy zero.

defaults.noValue: Not resolved — no processed-record rows. Check backend health and selector scope; backend unavailable is not a valid zero-record state.
